description: GitHub issue #30 comment 5384356411: 'I should be able to hover my mouse over it. After hovering, the relevant parts of the text should be highlighted on the right panel... When hovering over existing boxes, both the portions on the right hand panel and the existing pdf should be highlighted.' Depends on the 3-pane layout child (needs a right panel to highlight into) and the persistence child (needs a stable id linking a PDF-overlay box to its markdown record).

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
Implemented. crates/kovan/src/digitiser/gui/desktop/pdf_reader.rs: the PDF-side half (hover-highlighting an annotation box on the canvas) already existed from op-x9qn; this closes the other half. New `hover_created_at: Option<String>` field, set inside the canvas closure right after the existing per-frame `hovered` computation, using the annotation's `created_at` timestamp as a poor-man's stable id (it's already embedded verbatim in the markdown block op-96am's save action writes, e.g. `### annotation — 2026-08-24T...`). `context_panel` checks each rendered block against it and draws a highlighted frame around a match.

One frame of lag between the two (the right panel is drawn before the canvas in the same `ui()` call, so it reads last frame's hover state) -- imperceptible at interactive frame rates, and much simpler than restructuring draw order or introducing a second render pass.

Known, deliberate scope match with op-x9qn: only Annotate-type boxes link this way. A confirmed Digitise-graph/Read-table crop isn't tracked as a re-hoverable box in the reader (same limitation already documented on op-x9qn), so this linking only covers the "select text and annotate" half of the issue's ask, not table/graph CSV blocks -- those still show in the right panel (filtered by page, per op-0y4k) but without hover linking back to a specific PDF-side box.

cargo check --all-targets clean (native + aarch64-linux-android). cargo test --release: 187 kovan lib tests passing (unchanged -- this is pure GUI wiring with no new pure-function surface to unit-test beyond what op-0y4k already added). Not committed yet.

title: kovan-gui: hover-highlight linking between PDF annotation boxes and the right-hand markdown panel

description:
Child of op-mmep. New files mirroring examples/htgr_sim_v1/app/{mod,state,panels,schematic}.rs 1:1 in structure (report from 2026-08-15 exploration below), different physics backend.

app/state.rs: ColumnSnapshot (per-stage Vec<f64> for T/x/y/L/V, scalars for distillate/bottoms/reboiler_duty/reflux_ratio/sim_time_s/real_time pacing fields -- mirror HtgrSnapshot's control-inputs/outputs/clock section layout) + ColumnPlotData (time series Vec<[f64;2]> per key readout -- distillate purity, bottoms purity, reboiler duty, a couple of stage temperatures -- with the same MAX_PLOT_SAMPLES ring-buffer cap and push_capped helper HtgrPlotData uses).

app/mod.rs: DistColSimApp struct (physics: SharedState<ColumnSnapshot>, plots: SharedState<ColumnPlotData>, thread_health: ThreadHealth, open_panel: Panel, display_unit, last_sim_time_s) built via start_simulation() (spawn_physics_thread_monitored for the plant step loop + a second plot-sampler thread, exact two-thread pattern from examples/htgr_sim_v1/app/mod.rs:298-398) and restart_simulation() (thread_health.retire() then rebuild everything via a fresh start_simulation() call -- copy examples/htgr_sim_v1/app/mod.rs:464-475 verbatim in structure). eframe::App::ui draws: crash modal via show_crash_modal_with_restart + CrashModalOutcome::RestartRequested handling (copy examples/htgr_sim_v1/app/mod.rs:478-543's control flow exactly -- this IS the restart button the user asked for, already built and tested, not to be reinvented), top panel (title + theme + panel selector), right panel (draw_controls), central scrollable panel dispatching on Panel enum.

app/panels.rs: draw_controls (reflux ratio slider, reboiler duty slider, feed flow/composition sliders -- change-gated write-back via physics.update(|s| ...) only on .changed(), exactly like htgr_sim_v1's rod-insertion/helium-flow sliders at panels.rs's representative pattern), draw_schematic_panel, draw_plots_panel (egui_plot::Plot + Line per series), draw_diagnostics_panel (egui::Grid, one row per stage: T/x/y/L/V -- this is naturally TABULAR here since there are N stages, unlike HTGR's single-vessel readouts, so the diagnostics grid needs a stage-number column HTGR's does not).

app/schematic.rs: draw_schematic(ui, snapshot, tracers, display_unit) composing components::distillation_column (op-akkj) for the column body, components::condenser::CondenserVisual for the overhead condenser, components::heat_exchanger::HeatExchangerVisual for the reboiler, components::{pipe,bend}::PipeVisual for reflux/feed/distillate/bottoms streams -- same Stream-struct-plus-PipeVisual::from_scalars pattern htgr_sim_v1's schematic.rs uses, not custom-drawn shapes.

main.rs: eframe entry, Android no-op stub -- copy examples/htgr_sim_v1/main.rs's structure verbatim (cfg(target_os = android) empty main, eframe::run_native with a 1600x900 viewport).

Cargo.toml: add [[example]] name = distillation_sim_v1, path = examples/distillation_sim_v1/main.rs, alongside the existing htgr_sim_v1/fhr_sim_v2/widget_studio entries.

V&V: mirror examples/htgr_sim_v1/app/mod.rs's restarting_starts_a_fresh_run_and_abandons_the_old_one test -- advance a run, restart, assert sim_time_s resets and nothing carries over.

Depends on op-l6q9 (physics layer) and op-akkj (widget).

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
DONE 2026-08-15. examples/distillation_sim_v1/{main.rs, app/{mod,state,panels,schematic}.rs} + Cargo.toml [[example]] entry.

Mirrors htgr_sim_v1's app-scaffold usage closely: two-thread start_simulation (physics + plot-sampler, both under one ThreadHealth), restart_simulation via thread_health.retire() + fresh start_simulation(), show_crash_modal_with_restart wired into eframe::App::ui (confirmed this crate's eframe 0.34.3 uses fn ui(&mut self, ui: &mut egui::Ui, _frame), not the classic fn update -- matched htgr_sim_v1 exactly, including the non-deprecated egui::Panel::top/right API htgr_sim_v1 already uses over the deprecated TopBottomPanel/SidePanel aliases). THIS IS THE RESTART BUTTON THE USER ASKED FOR, reused as-is via show_crash_modal_with_restart -- no new restart mechanism was built.

Diagnostics panel is a stage-indexed grid (T/x/y/L/V per row) since this plant has N equilibrium stages, unlike HTGR's single-vessel readouts -- the one structural place this app genuinely differs from its template.

Schematic composes the new DistillationColumnVisual (op-akkj) for the column body; the four external streams (feed/reflux/distillate/bottoms) are drawn as plain labelled arrows rather than through components::pipe::PipeVisual, because that widget's scalar path needs a mass flow rate and this plant is a molar-balance model with no mass flow computed anywhere -- routing through it would mean inventing a quantity the model does not produce. Documented in schematic.rs's module doc.

V&V test restarting_starts_a_fresh_run_and_abandons_the_old_one (mirrors htgr_sim_v1's own test of the same name): initial version had a test-design bug (asserted after_restart < advanced_to at a point where sim_time_s is quantised to exactly one tick's value for both runs, so a correct restart could still read equal) -- caught by actually running it, fixed by requiring run 1 to advance several ticks before restarting so there is real headroom. Documented in the test's own doc comment as a note for future readers, not silently fixed.

Gates: cargo test --release -p outram-park-digital-twin-engine --example distillation_sim_v1 -> 3 passed, 0 failed. cargo build --release clean. Android check clean (--lib --example distillation_sim_v1 --example htgr_sim_v1 --target aarch64-linux-android).

NOT independently visually verified: attempted to launch the GUI under Xvfb in this container (installed libxkbcommon-x11-0 to get past an initial missing-library panic) but hit a WGPU 'Failed to create surface for any enabled backend' error at window creation. Confirmed this is a CONTAINER-WIDE limitation, not a defect here: the pre-existing htgr_sim_v1 example hits the byte-identical error in the same environment. So the panel layout / schematic rendering has NOT been eyeballed in this session; it is verified only by successful compilation, the type system, and the tests above.

title: distillation_sim_v1: app layer -- state/panels/schematic/mod + restart button
